title: orthosia bonplandiana
intro: Orthosia bonplandiana, commonly known as the night-flowering jasmine or night-blooming jasmine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Oleaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as sedative and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Orthosia bonplandiana include its ability to induce relaxation, reduce stress, and promote a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been found to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
